culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Sumiya Nishino. He planned to commit suicide and frame Raito Fujide for his death as well as the others. He made Wada go to the toilet by making Wada to write his name on the paper which have four torn edges. Nishino also made him and Kawasaki the ones to investigate the noise by hiding a full mint case inside his sleeve while shaking the empty one. Kogoro deduces that the noise is made by Nishino himself using another phone. He also poured honey on Kawasaki's phone and made him touch the screen by sending a message. evidence.quote: The code Kogoro received reads "It's time to play ball." The code stuck to the chapel door reads "One out in the toilet." The code found in the rooms reads "Two outs in the bath." The code found next to Kawasaki's body reads "Three outs in the study." The code handed to Fujide reads "Perfect game." Motive Nishino found out that his highschool baseball team lost a game against another highschool attached to Shinano University on purpose while he is injured.

motive.zhHans: 由于 Kawasaki 有洁癖，他会前往洗手间洗手。Nishino 因为自己当时不在场、没能阻止球队故意输球而感到沮丧。由于 Nichihara 在短时间内投了 42 局、约 1000 球，他的肩膀已到了极限。Wada 建议故意输球，因为 Nichihara 坚持要投到最后。“一分钟都不该浪费。”随后，在心里，Komei 说道：“正如俗话所说，时间就是金钱。”漫画与动画的差异主条目：漫画与动画差异列表 Ikue 的头发在漫画中是黑色的，在动画中改为金色，而 Raito 原本的金色头发则改为深棕色。
motive.en: Since Kawasaki is a clean freak, he will head to the toilet to wash his hands. Nishino was frustated because he was not there to stop the team losing on purpose. Because Nichihara played 42 innings and threw roughly 1000 pitches in a short amount of time, his shoulder was at its limit. Wada suggested to lose on purpose because Nichihara insisted on pitching until the end otherwise. Not a moment should be wasted." After that, in his thoughts, Komei says "As they say, time is money." Manga to anime changes Main article: List of differences between the manga and anime Ikue's hair is black in the manga, when in the anime is changed to blonde, while Raito's originally blonde hair is changed to dark brown.

method.zhHans: 突然，Nishino 开始尖叫，并试图吞下一枚装有毒药的药丸，结果被毛利小五郎阻止。自杀未遂地点：长野县一座废弃教堂受害者：Sumiya Nishino 年龄：28 岁时间：夜间作案手法：水瓶中的毒药犯人是 Sumiya Nishino。毛利小五郎推断出那个声音是 Nishino 本人用另一部手机制造的。Nishino 还在 Kawasaki 的手帕上涂了毒药。江户川柯南注意到 Kawasaki 洗手时会咬住手帕，因此毒药很容易沾到他的嘴唇上，毒药是在他喝水时被吞下的。Kawasaki 死亡的场景在动画中更长，因为我们看到了他慢慢死于毒药发作的过程，而漫画只显示了他的尸体。
method.en: Suddenly, Nishino starts screaming and tries to consume a pill containing poison, only to be stopped be Kogoro. Attempted Suicide Location: Abandoned church in Nagano Prefecture Victim: Sumiya Nishino Age: 28 years old Time: At night Modus operandi: Poison from water bottle The culprit is Sumiya Nishino. Kogoro deduces that the noise is made by Nishino himself using another phone. Nishino also applied poison to Kawasaki's handkerchief. Conan noticed that Kawasaki bites his handkerchief while washing his hand, so the poison can easily get onto his lips, and the poison was swallowed while he was drinking. The scene where Kawasaki dies is longer in the anime, as we see the process of him slowly dying from the effects of the poison, whereas the manga only shows his corpse.

evidence.zhHans: 毛利小五郎收到的暗号写着：“该打球了。”贴在教堂门上的暗号写着：“厕所一人出局。”在房间里发现的暗号写着：“浴室两人出局。”在 Kawasaki 的尸体旁发现的暗号写着：“书房三人出局。”交给 Fujide 的暗号写着：“完全比赛。”动机 Nishino 得知，在他受伤期间，他的高中棒球队故意输掉了与信州大学附属高中的一场比赛。和叶晃平的尸体在漫画中被发现时眼睛是睁开的，而动画版该场景中他的眼睛是闭着的。
evidence.en: The code Kogoro received reads "It's time to play ball." The code stuck to the chapel door reads "One out in the toilet." The code found in the rooms reads "Two outs in the bath." The code found next to Kawasaki's body reads "Three outs in the study." The code handed to Fujide reads "Perfect game." Motive Nishino found out that his highschool baseball team lost a game against another highschool attached to Shinano University on purpose while he is injured. Kouhei Wada's eyes are open when his body is found in the manga, but the anime version of the scene has his eyes closed.

resolution.zhHans: Fujide 突然收到 Nishino 发来的一条讯息，Nishino 声称他知道犯人是谁，并要求 Fujide 在无人察觉的情况下前往书房。进入房间后，Nishino 递给他另一张暗号纸。突然，Nishino 开始尖叫，并试图吞下一枚装有毒药的药丸，结果被毛利小五郎阻止。自杀未遂
resolution.en: Fujide suddenly receives a message from Nishino, claiming that he knows who the culprit is, and asks Fujide to come to the study room without anyone noticing. After arriving inside the room, Nishino gives him another code sheet. Suddenly, Nishino starts screaming and tries to consume a pill containing poison, only to be stopped be Kogoro. Attempted Suicide
